title: Accounting for Government and Not-For-Profit Organizations
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: Accounting for Government and Not-For-Profit Organizations - Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Demonstrate analysis and critical reflection appropriate in the field of accounting.
Demonstrate communication and problem solving appropriate in the field on accounting.
Plan and prepare for employment and career advancement in the field of governmental accounting and not-for-profit accounting.
Recognize the need for, and implement ethical decision making.

blocks.name: Requirements for the Certificate of Achievement (CA)

notes: The page's top heading names a Certificate of Achievement, but the Summary, Requirements and Other subheadings say 'Certificate of Career Preparation'. The requirements list is explicitly labeled 'Requirements for the Certificate of Achievement (CA)', so it was read as this award. A reviewer should confirm the subheadings are a labeling error.
The 'Field on accounting' typo in the second outcome is copied as printed.

The description mentions 'employment in government or not-for-profit organizations'. This was read as a description of the employment sector, not a named career or job title, so careers is left empty. A reviewer should check this reading.
Units: 14.00 and Total: 14.00 are printed for the requirements.
